messages:
sam (PM): quick sync on Optimize toolkit MVP — need decision: batching heuristics, prefix cache, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts. Acme/HealthCo pushing cache+quant first. opinions?

maria (Eng): cache + batching is lowest lift and biggest immediate perf win. quant recs require bench infra but we can ship family-level guidance. eval alerts are bigger (storage + hooks).

aj (ML): agree. v1 quant: coarse profiles (int8 / 4-bit family mapping). per-model tuning later. will define bench matrix.

tess (Solutions): customers will accept coarse quant recs if we provide rollout checklist + rollback steps. add canary guidance.

sam (PM): propose MVP scope: 1) batching heuristics + runtime defaults, 2) prefix/KV cache with TTLs, 3) coarse quant recommendations. exclude user-facing eval alerts from MVP, but include canary infra for internal checks. timeline: beta in ~7w?

maria (Eng): doable if we freeze to family-level profiles and no per-model tuning. API surface: /recommendations endpoint + console action to apply profile. example payload:
```json
{"model":"redwood-open-7b","recommended_profile":"int8_fast","expected_savings":"~30%","quality_delta":"~0.8%"}
```

leo (SRE): canary defaults: 5% traffic for 24h + perf and quality gates, auto rollback on regressions. that requires minimal eval infra; we can later expose eval-triggered alerts as product feature.

aj (ML): acceptance criteria: bench shows >=20% token cost reduction on 3 of 5 pilot workloads; quality delta <2% on held evals.

tess (Solutions): I'll draft customer comms and rollout checklist.

sam (PM): action items: maria sprint plan + ETA, aj bench matrix in 2w, leo canary spec in 1w, tess checklist in 2w. deploy-bot: create tickets.

deploy-bot: created tickets INF-1488, ML-230, UI-309.

sam (PM): thanks — syncing again in 2w. :rocket:
